description: Ghostty's macOS default split keys that cmux-next keeps (plans/cmux-next/terminal-shortcuts.md, 'Ghostty-default shortcuts'). In every pane focus listed in `contexts`, each reserved key runs its `command`, and no other default binding may claim the key there. Read by GhosttyReservedKeysTests (CmuxNextActionsTests, the shipped binding table) and scripts/cmux-next/check-ghostty-reserved-keys.py (the exported default keymap, pre-push gate and CI). Changing or removing an entry needs the user's explicit OK (Lawrence 2026-10-20: Cmd-Opt-arrows were rebound to sidebar switching by 2f3e1f95983; 'We need to ensure this never happens again'). Keys use keybindings.json syntax.

scopedOwners.description: Focus keys where a reserved key may run something else: text fields and editors that use the key for editing. A binding on a reserved key that is not the reserved command must have a `when` that is false in every context above.
